method: Read-only Production RPC on three canonical-token five-word inputs; rerun V32 against a temporary in-query projection of first three tokens from each result. No persistent SQL objects or data writes.
finding: A bounded prefix core can be recovered by existing V32 in all three cases, but prefix recovery cannot validate the unexamined tail or establish whole-sentence syntax. The source expression candidate distinguishes only exact i dag from near negatives, not its syntactic function.
contract_implications: Maintain separate core_candidate and tail_status with token coverage and canonical identities.
Never label a full-sentence parse or resolved adjunct merely because prefix V32 succeeds.
Do not promote R072 temporal-tail core-survival or R073 bridge to PROVEN from this test.
Before a graph patch, prove scoped-core invariants plus SVO/OVS subject disambiguation and a release-authorized tail consumer.
limits: Two near negatives test lexical expression selectivity, not whether the entire Norwegian sentences are ungrammatical. This is a diagnostic proof, not an activated rule or implementation.
